race.description: Ladbrokes New Betslip Qtis 3YO Mdn Hcp
race.comment: ZOU ZOU ZIPORA (9) has the right profile after a sound second at Toowoomba, where she was checked near the 1100m yet still fought on to be beaten a length and a half. Her third two back also had merit after she worked home from well back, and first-time blinkers add another genuine angle for a filly already placed twice around 1200m. MONARCHAL (16) is the clear danger after a fourth at Gold Coast, beaten two lengths despite a messy run with several incidents, and the inside draw gives him the chance to convert improving form into a maiden win. IT'SALL ABOUT MARY (10) returns from a freshening after missing by a nose at this track, so she brings proven course form, although she is still chasing the breakthrough over this distance range. PLAYMATE PAMELA (8) a close Deagon trial second and first-time blinkers make her an interesting debutant. Watch the betting.
